newsitem.title: USA: Sun plans January '97 turnarounds for Girard Point.
newsitem.headline: Sun plans January '97 turnarounds for Girard Point.

text.p: Sun Co Inc plans to conduct maintenance turnarounds at units within its Philadelphia, Pa., refinery system starting in mid-January, the company said Monday.
At the Philadelphia refinery, a 17-day turnaround of a 38,000 barrels-per-day (bpd) reformer at the Girard Point processing facility will begin on January 15.
A separate 40-day turnaround of an 18,000 bpd alkylation unit, also at Girard Point, will start a week later on January 22, the company said.
There are no major maintenance turnarounds slated for Sun's Marcus Hook, Pa., refinery in the first quarter of 1997.
